partial means relevant writing exists but a required component remains open.

unassessed means coverage is unsettled; it must not be counted as unwritten.
Known gaps and assessment limits below are reproduced from the saved coverage rows.
They may predate the latest writing. Recent writing exceptions take precedence over a blanket absence claim.
Planned section numbers are TOC/catalog identifiers, not guaranteed current rendered LaTeX section numbers.
